title: Among customers who paid in CZK and made transactions at gas stations in th
question: Among customers who paid in CZK and made transactions at gas stations in the Czech Republic, which year had the highest total consumption?

prediction.sql:
SELECT SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) AS Year
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c."XCL_001" = ym."XCL_019"
WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
  AND c."XCL_001" IN (
    SELECT t."XCL_013"
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t."XCL_015" = g."XCL_004"
    WHERE g."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
  )
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(ym."XCL_021") DESC
LIMIT 1
